AU.note: An overseas licence works at first; rules differ by state. Weekend car-shares are the student favourite.

MY.note: Grab is cheap and everywhere — most students skip owning a car.

TW.note: Scooter culture: you need a local licence, and helmets are non-negotiable.

GB.note: Insurance for young drivers is brutal — students live on trains and buses.

SG.note: COE makes cars luxury items — the MRT reaches every campus.

NZ.note: Cheap used cars everywhere; convert your licence within 12 months.

RU.note: The metro beats driving in Moscow and St Petersburg.

US.note: A car helps in Los Angeles; Boston, New York and Chicago transit is enough.

CA.note: Winter tyres are law in parts of Canada; student transit passes are discounted.

CN.note: Foreign licences need local conversion — DiDi and the metro cover everything.
